title: Project Gutenberg website vandalism, Nov 15, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Project Gutenberg, the Project Gutenberg Literary Archive Foundation, ibiblio, any news outlet, government agency, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: A free library of tens of thousands of public-domain books, used worldwide. The site has been down since Nov 15-16, but the foundation says the book files appear clear. Volunteers run recovery.
who_is_affected: Readers who use gutenberg.org, and sites and tools that link to or load books from it. Contributors who use ibiblio logins cannot upload. The books appear unaffected.

known.text: The foundation says gutenberg.org was hit by vandalism and is being rebuilt.
Its updates describe outside attackers, injected code and root access to a server.
As of 5:12 AM ET on Nov 21, gutenberg.org still shows a 503 maintenance page.
ibiblio, which hosts Gutenberg services, reports its own unplanned outage that began on Nov 15.

not_known.text: Whether any user data was exposed.
Whether the ibiblio outage is the same incident.
